# Avatar Stage

Characters & Collectibles · Live demo & interactive props: `/cumulus#/avatar-stage`

Source-module importers: **3** (value imports outside docs and test/type fixtures; not a production-liveness measure).

The full-body Avatar art layer for a caller-owned stage: `standing` adds a low ambient glow, `cutout` preserves the underlying scene, and `fullBleed` supplies a cinematic backdrop and head-focused composition.

> **Guidance:** Place this component inside a position-relative stage whose width, height, overflow, and placement belong to the caller.

Use Avatar Portrait for framed profile crops and semantic profile reveals.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `avatar` | `AvatarVisual` | yes | — | The Avatar whose full-body art fills the stage. |
| `variant` | `AvatarStageVariant` = `"fullBleed" \| "standing" \| "cutout"` | yes | — | `standing` adds an ambient glow, `cutout` preserves the scene, and `fullBleed` adds a cinematic backdrop. |

### `avatar`: the `AvatarVisual` model

| Field | Type | Optional | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `imageNumber` | `string` | no |  |
| `name` | `LocalizedString` | no |  |
| `title` | `LocalizedString` | yes |  |
| `portraitFocus` | `AvatarPortraitFocus` | yes | Normalized head position used to center subject-aware crops. |

## Usage

### Standing figure

Full-body art over the ambient selection glow.

```tsx
import { AvatarStage } from "src/cumulus/components/hud/AvatarStage";

<div style={{ position: "relative", width: 320, height: 480 }}>
  <AvatarStage avatar={avatar} variant="standing" />
</div>
```

### Scene-preserving cutout

Full-body art with no component-owned backdrop.

```tsx
<div style={{ position: "relative", width: 320, height: 480 }}>
  <AvatarStage avatar={avatar} variant="cutout" />
</div>
```

### Cinematic showcase

Head-focused full-body art over the cinematic backdrop.

```tsx
<div style={{ position: "relative", width: 320, height: 480 }}>
  <AvatarStage avatar={avatar} variant="fullBleed" />
</div>
```
